features: ✅ Up to 50H Playtime (Long Battery Life Wireless Headphones): Enjoy up to 50 hours of uninterrupted entertainment with GOBOULT Orbit wireless headphones. Designed for extended listening sessions, these Bluetooth headphones keep your favourite music, podcasts and videos going throughout the day. Ideal for office use, travel, daily commutes and relaxing at home, these long battery life headphones deliver convenient entertainment whenever you need it.

✅ 40mm Bass Boost Drivers (Over-Ear Bass Headphones): Experience powerful bass and immersive audio with 40mm dynamic bass boost drivers. Designed to deliver rich sound for music, movies, videos and gaming, GOBOULT Orbit over-ear headphones enhance your everyday listening experience. Whether you enjoy bass-heavy tracks or your favourite playlists, these wireless Bluetooth headphones offer engaging sound for music lovers.

✅ 16-Bit DSP Technology (Digital Sound Wireless Headphones): Experience digital sound processing with 16-bit DSP technology, designed to support consistent audio reproduction. Combined with 40mm bass boost drivers, it makes GOBOULT Orbit suitable for enjoying music, podcasts, movies and other compatible audio content. These Bluetooth wireless headphones offer a versatile listening experience for everyday entertainment, work and leisure.

✅ Zen ENC Mic (Wireless Headphones with Mic): Stay connected with the integrated Zen Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) microphone, designed to help reduce surrounding environmental noise during calls. These wireless headphones with mic support convenient voice communication for work calls, online conversations and everyday use. Enjoy hands-free calling while working, studying or travelling with the GOBOULT Orbit wireless headset.

✅ 60ms Low Latency (Gaming Bluetooth Headphones): Enjoy a more synchronised audio experience with 60ms low latency technology. Designed for compatible gaming and entertainment applications, this feature helps reduce the delay between on-screen action and sound. GOBOULT Orbit gaming Bluetooth headphones are suitable for mobile gaming, watching videos and interactive entertainment where audio synchronisation matters.
